description.value: Sooke Oceanside Brewery is a craft microbrewery and taproom on the southern tip of Vancouver Island, pouring a rotating lineup of west coast-style beers brewed on-site — from blonde ales and IPAs to seasonal schwarzbiers and hard seltzers. The taproom features an ocean-view patio and a lively events calendar including Open Mic Nights and stand-up comedy. Cyclists passing through Sooke on the Westshore or heading toward the Juan de Fuca Trail will find the Grilled To The Mac food truck stationed in the courtyard, serving locally sourced food alongside the house brews.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and confirms the business is an active craft brewery taproom at 5871-A Sooke Rd, Sooke, BC V9Z 0C7, with phone 778-352-2739 — neither of which was present in OSM tags (OSM had no phone; address lacked city/postal). The food menu page confirms no full kitchen but references an associated food truck (Grilled To The Mac) in the courtyard. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields are null per evidence-only rules.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; 778-352-2739 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there is no OSM value to cross-check.

Website homepage states 'Our New Location Is Now Open', suggesting a recent relocation; the confirmed address 5871-A Sooke Rd matches the OSM housenumber/unit tags, so no conflict, but worth noting the move is recent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible craft brewery taproom with a confirmed website, address, and phone. A natural stop for touring cyclists on Sooke Road.
enrichment_extras.notes: Food service is limited to small in-house snacks; the courtyard food truck (Grilled To The Mac) is a separate business. Cyclists needing a full meal should confirm the food truck is operating before arrival.
